front.title: vCon for AI Agent Conversations: Requirements, Gaps and Extension Roadmap

abstract.t: AI agents converse with people, other agents and tools. There is a growing need to capture these conversations for audit, compliance and review. This document sorts the requirements for capturing agent conversations into those that fit vCon, those better met by plain logging and those that need other solutions. It then identifies the gaps in vCon and proposes a strawman set of vCon extensions to fill them. It is intended as a discussion document.
